code: extract_rap(   year,   geometry,   cover = names(RAP_BANDS),   units = c("ha", "km2", "m2", "acres", "mi2"),   id = NULL,   wide = FALSE,   cache_dir = NULL,   chunk_size = 500L,   workers = 4L,   cores = 1L,   quiet = FALSE )

title: Extract RAP vegetation cover for polygons — extract_rap
text: year Integer, 1986 2025. geometry sf/sfc object, terra::SpatVector, path vector file sf::st_read() can open. Polygons . Must fall within CONUS. cover Cover types return, RAP band codes: "AFG" (annual forb grass), "BGR" (bare ground), "LTR" (litter), "PFG" (perennial forb grass), "SHR" (shrub), "TRE" (tree). Case insensitive. Defaults 6. units Area units: one "ha", "km2", "m2", "acres", "mi2". id Optional column name geometry use feature id. Defaults row number. wide TRUE, return one row per feature pct_<band> area_<band> columns. Default FALSE returns long (tidy) format. cache_dir Directory cached tiles. Defaults persistent user cache (tools::R_user_dir("fastrap", "cache")). chunk_size Features per chunk. Lower memory tight. workers Parallel download workers. Raise fast connection. cores Worker processes extraction (forked; Unix/macOS , ignored Windows). quiet Suppress progress messages.

title: Extract RAP vegetation cover for polygons — extract_rap
text: data.frame. Long format columns: id, year, band (RAP band code: AFG, BGR, LTR, PFG, SHR, TRE), cover_type, pct (area-weighted mean percent cover feature's cells data), area (pct / 100 times feature's area, units). Bands sum 100: RAP predicts cover type separately.

title: Extract RAP vegetation cover for polygons — extract_rap
text: Speed comes four things: 2048 x 2048 pixel windows national cloud-optimized GeoTIFF touch features read, using HTTP range requests. Nothing national downloaded. Windows fetched parallel workers (works Windows ) cached disk, repeat calls area skip network. Windows snap RAP grid, resampling happens. Extraction uses exact, cell-area-weighted coverage fractions (exactextractr, C++). Memory stays flat large layers: features sorted spatially run chunks chunk_size, chunk reads tiles lazy VRT. RAP built rangelands. authors note cover estimates may suit forests agricultural land.
